body.name: Global blocked-state BIC
body.construction: For \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), set \(d_{E_0}=p+\sum_{j\in V}|\Pi^{E_0}_j|\). If \(S_n\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), compute the attained statewise Gaussian likelihood using the target-local systems in \(\texttt{def:off-model-block-ls}\) and set \(\operatorname{BIC}_n(E_0)=-2\sup_{\Sigma\in\mathcal M(E_0)}\ell_n(\Sigma)+d_{E_0}\log n\). If \(S_n\notin\mathbb S^p_{++}\), set \(\operatorname{BIC}_n(E_0)=d_{E_0}\log n\). Let \(\widehat C_n\) be the minimizer under a fixed ordering of \(\mathfrak S_p\).
